title: Rogue Marine Adventures
specs: Crew are retired and active duty military members with local knowledge and experience.
Private tours accommodate up to 8 people.
blurb: Guests join private tours lasting 3-4 hours to Morgan "Monkey" Island, departing from several pickup spots in the Beaufort area. Tours accommodate up to 8 people and welcome pets. The crew consists of retired and active duty military members with deep local knowledge and a focus on safety and camaraderie.
extraNote: All bookings must be made in advance and are subject to availability. · A deposit may be required at the time of booking. · Full payment must be made before the service commences. · Cancellations made more than 36 hours before the scheduled service will receive a full refund. · Cancellations made within 24 hours of the scheduled service will be charged 50% of the booking fee. · No-shows will be charged the full booking fee. · The Company reserves the right to cancel or reschedule services due to weather conditions, safety concerns, or other unforeseen circumstances with full refund or reschedule option. · Customers must adhere to all safety instructions and guidelines provided by the Company
